verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents edge functions or edge middleware written in Python, Go, or Rust. The Container Runtime lets regional Vercel Functions run any language from a Dockerfile, but that is a different compute tier, not edge execution, so it earns no credit. A community remark that Vercel offers only 'JS/TS/Go, or WebAssembly gimmicks' refers to the platform generally and does not show multi-language edge support.

support.subject: As a developer, I can write edge functions in languages other than JavaScript such as Python, Go, or Rust
